system.description:
You conjure a giant Stone construct made of earth, dust, soil, and sand forming a large Stone Dragon that obeys your commands.

The Stone Dragon has the listed statistics found on its stat block in the Summon Stat Blocks section and use your Ninjutsu attack bonus or Ninjutsu Save DC when an effect calls for it. You can command them as a Bonus action.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the dragons hit points by 20.
